{{Top|leg}}
'''Zenithal InQuestor of Judgment''' was a title held by [[Halmere]], a former [[High Inquisitor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who had joined the Imperial splinter movement known as the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. Halmere inherited that title after his predecessor, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Kyle Katarn]].
